title: Infinitive: decide / want / hope + to
grammarTitle: Infinitives — Verbs That Take to + Base Form
grammarNote: После некоторых глаголов в английском языке обязательно используется инфинитив (to + base form). Эти глаголы, как правило, выражают решения, намерения, желания, надежды, ожидания и отказы. Нельзя после них использовать герундий. Это нужно запомнить как лексику.

grammarExtra.title: Full list: verbs always followed by infinitive

rows.example: "I want TO go." / "She needs TO rest." / "I'd like TO try." ✅
"Decided TO apply." / "Planned TO leave." / "Agreed TO help." ✅
"Hope TO pass." / "Expect TO arrive." / "Mean TO call." ✅
"Promised TO help." / "Offered TO drive." / "Failed TO submit." ✅
"Learned TO swim." / "Managed TO pass." / "Can't afford TO wait." ✅
"She told ME TO leave." / "He asked HER TO wait." ✅
"I want YOU TO help." / "She needs HIM TO stop." ✅
"They allowed US TO enter." / "She permitted THEM TO stay." ✅
"She encouraged ME TO apply." / "He helped HER TO finish." ✅

grammarExtra.title: Verbs that change meaning: gerund vs infinitive

rows.example: "She stopped SMOKING." = She no longer smokes. ✅
"She stopped TO smoke." = She paused (in order) to smoke. ✅
"I remember POSTING the letter." = I recall doing it.
"Remember TO post the letter." = Don't forget to do it!
"Try EATING less sugar." = Experiment with this approach.
"Try TO eat less sugar." = Make an effort to do so.

grammarTip:
Инфинитив (to + глагол) — запомни глаголы:

want, need, decide, plan, hope,
promise, offer, refuse, agree, expect,
manage, learn, tend, afford, fail,
choose, intend, mean, wish

→ Все они + to + base form (НИКОГДА + V-ing!)

💡 Verb + Object + Infinitive:
"She told ME TO leave." ✅
"I want YOU TO help." ✅
"He asked HER TO wait." ✅

⚠️ Глаголы с изменением значения:
"stop SMOKING" (бросить) vs "stop TO SMOKE" (остановиться чтобы)
"remember POSTING" (помню что отправил) vs
"remember TO POST" (не забудь отправить!)

exercises.text: She decided ___ to a different university.

exercises.hint: "want" + INFINITIVE. "I want TO SPEAK English fluently." ✅
"hope" + INFINITIVE. "He hopes TO PASS the exam." ✅

exercises.text: "She stopped ___ when she heard the news." (cry)
opts: to cry (she paused in order to cry)
exercises.hint: "stopped CRYING" = she was crying, and then she stopped. The crying ended. ✅

exercises.text: "Remember ___ the lights before you leave!" (turn off)
opts: to turn off (future task — don't forget)
exercises.correct: to turn off (future task — don't forget)
exercises.hint: "Remember TO turn off" = don't forget to do it in the future! ✅ "Remember TURNING off" = I recall having done it.
"tell + object + TO + base". "She told him TO CLOSE the door." ✅

exercises.text: "Try ___ less coffee — it might help your sleep." (drink)
exercises.hint: "Try DRINKING less coffee" = experiment with this approach. "Try TO drink less" = make an effort to reduce. Both work but meaning shifts!

exercises.text: She offered ___ us at the airport.

exercises.hint: "expect" + INFINITIVE. "I expect TO RECEIVE a reply." ✅

questions.hint: "manage" + INFINITIVE. "They managed TO MEET the deadline." ✅

questions.text: "I stopped ___ when I realised it was wrong." (+ infinitive means...)
opts: to smoke (paused in order to smoke)
questions.correct: to smoke (paused in order to smoke)
questions.hint: "stopped TO smoke" = stopped [what I was doing] IN ORDER TO smoke. The infinitive = purpose. ✅
"Remember TO turn off" = don't forget to do it (future task). ✅
"ask + object + TO + base". "She asked him TO HELP." ✅

questions.text: "She failed ___ the assignment on time." Choose.

questions.hint: "plan" + INFINITIVE. "I plan TO TRAVEL after graduation." ✅
"want + object + TO + base". "I want you TO CHECK this." ✅

questions.text: "Try ___ the problem from a different angle." (experiment)
questions.hint: "Try APPROACHING" = experiment with this approach. "Try TO approach" = make an effort. Both are possible with "try"!
"encourage + object + TO + base". "She encouraged him TO APPLY." ✅

questions.text: "I remember ___ you the answer." — I recall doing it in the past.
questions.hint: "remember TELLING" = I have a memory of having told you (past action). ✅
